headline: CaLR proposes causal-topology-guided latent revision for diffusion reasoning
summary: A September 17 preprint proposes Causal Latent Revision (CaLR), a method for diffusion language models that uses a teacher model to extract concept-level dependencies and then guides latent updates with a causal topology matrix and implicit differentiation. The authors evaluate a LoRA-tuned LLaDA-8B on several reasoning and coding tasks. The paper's numerical account is internally difficult to reconcile: §4.2 reports GSM8K accuracy of 58.36%, while Table 1's flattened header and CaLR-8B values leave the corresponding task column ambiguous. This review records the proposed method but does not rely on disputed performance magnitudes; results remain author-reported and unreproduced.
